title: Grown
author: Tiffany D. Jackson
current_text: Frisco Independent School District in Texas banned Grown from libraries and classrooms in October 2022. Beaufort County School District in South Carolina banned Grown pending investigation in October 2022. Clay County School District in Florida banned Grown pending investigation in September 2022. Escambia County Public Schools in Florida banned Grown pending investigation in October 2022.
